title: Starting and caring for a garden
competency: List the basic steps to start a garden and explain garden care.

keywords.def: Working for yourself, not for an employer.
A prepared area of soil where plants are grown.
Gathering the crop when it is ready.

ideas.name: Eight steps to start a garden

en.text: Gardening can be a profitable business. To start, decide what to grow, choose a location, plan the beds, get tools, choose seeds or transplants, plant with care, nurture the garden and enjoy the harvest. Care is the most important duty, and the gardener must prepare for times with little rain.
